SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF DEC-02-2021 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF DEC-02-2021 BY MICHELLE TONG. PLAINTIFF RWHI ZEIDAN IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT MERCEDES-BENZ OF SAN FRANCISCO IS PRESENT REPRESENTED BY TROY DAVIS, SERVICE DIRECTOR. DEFENDANT WAIVES SERVICE. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF DEC-02-2021 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF ZEIDAN, RWHI IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT MERCEDES-BENZ OF SAN FRANCISCO INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE THAT DEFENDANT CAUSED THE ELECTRIC STEERING LOCK TO MALFUNCTION. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF OCT-06-2021 - CONTINUED FOR PROOF OF SERVICE TO DEC-02-2021 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF RWHI ZEIDAN IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT MERCEDES BENZ OF SAN FRANCISCO IS NOT PRESENT. COURT ADDRESS ISSUE OF SERVICE WITH PLAINTIFF. COURT DETERMINES THAT SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM WAS DONE ON THE WRONG ENTITY. SERVICE WAS DONE ON MERCEDES-BENZ CLUB OF AMERICA, INC., SAN FRANCISCO-BAY AREA SECTION AND NOT TO THE NAMED DEFENDANT, MERCEDES-BENZ OF SAN FRANCISCO. PROOF OF SERVICE FILED IS NOT VALID. COURT DISCLOSURE REGARDING CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS IS MADE. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS ARE REVIEWED AND RETURNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED. (506)
